text.en:
The provincial board of Cebu is hereby authorized to loan from provincial funds the sum of live
hundred pesos to the municipality of Asturias, in the Province of Cebu, to be used for the purpose of
relieving distress in said municipality caused by fire and by the marauds of bandits, and to be repaid to the
provincial treasury, without interest, on or before January first, nineteen hundred and six.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 1, 1905.
